message:
Merhav: the mobile and long-case update is published.

Open: https://elad-refoua.github.io/iser-clinician-portal/ — use your existing login.

Sonnet now has a $2 per-request allowance and a longer response window. Three live fictional long-case runs with about 85,000 input tokens completed successfully. The $10 daily and $20 total caps remain.

The mobile walkthrough covered chat, live questions and drafts, approval, intake editing, history and restoration from the server. Layout and touch-control issues were fixed. Testing used Chromium phone-size emulation; physical phones and Safari were not tested.

336 automated tests passed. A compatibility problem with historical intake traces was also fixed without rewriting saved records.

Hebrew prompt/experience review based on your simulation agent: https://github.com/elad-refoua/iser-clinician-portal/blob/main/Verification_2026-10-18/PROMPT_EXPERIENCE_RECOMMENDATIONS.md

Updated handbook: https://elad-refoua.github.io/iser-clinician-portal/handbook.pdf

No further setup is needed. This remains a fictional-case environment; model proposals still need review.
note: Delivery was not confirmed: local bridge returned HTTP500. Subsequent read-only getMe checks failed with ECONNRESET in Node and ConnectionResetError in Python; no direct send was attempted.
